item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00493","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C13","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is a direct and material template: it establishes an almost identically named national mobilization-policy advisory body, assigns it an advisory function within the mobilization apparatus, and specifies representation drawn from business, labor, agriculture, and the general public. The child preserves that core machinery while converting the Committee into a presidential Board chaired by the Director of Defense Mobilization and adding detailed operational, compensation, ethics-exemption, travel, and funding provisions. C13 strongly explains the child's distinctive uncompensated-service and statutory-exemption clause, but it does not supply the central board design as directly as C03. C25 supplies a weaker general board pattern involving presidential appointments, advice and reports to the President, travel allowances, and funding.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established the National Advisory Board on Mobilization Policy","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established the National Advisory Committee on Mobilization Policy","explanation":"The body’s distinctive name and institutional purpose are retained almost verbatim, with only “Committee” changed to “Board.”"},{"child_excerpt":"four members of the Board shall have had experience in business management, four members shall have had experience in matters relating to labor, and four members shall have had experience in agriculture","parent_excerpt":"shall include persons whose experience and ability equip them to represent business, labor, agriculture, and the public as a whole","explanation":"The child converts C03’s same four constituency categories into fixed membership allocations."},{"child_excerpt":"It shall be the function of the Board to advise the President from time to time with respect to the current defense mobilization program or any phase thereof.","parent_excerpt":"to consult with and advise the National Security Resources Board on national mobilization policy","explanation":"Both create a public advisory body for national mobilization policy; the child adapts the recipient of advice to the reorganized mobilization structure."},{"child_excerpt":"All of the members of the Board shall represent the general public and the public interest","parent_excerpt":"the problems of military, industrial and civilian mobilization concern all of the people of the United States ... persons ... to represent business, labor, agriculture, and the public as a whole","explanation":"The child preserves C03’s public-interest framing while formalizing it as a membership qualification."}]}
